top_signals.title: Global shipping authorities warn of maritime trade breakdown amid geopolitical turmoil
top_signals.summary: Eighteen maritime bodies warned Tuesday that geopolitical tensions and a growing shadow fleet threaten to undermine international shipping and weaken trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
